stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the study is hindlimb unloading (disuse) and reloading into normal cage activity versus active cage controls (S2.2.p1). No group performs exercise training or an exercise bout, so the requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable. Reloading R1/R3/R7 vs D7 would be recovery from disuse, not exercise, and was not run as a substitute.
